months.title: Months
months.description: Which monthly threads to read, as YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-09) or "latest". Leave empty for the current month (or the latest thread if this month's isn't posted yet).

threadType.title: Thread
enumTitles: Who wants to be hired? (people looking for work)
threadType.description: Which monthly thread to read. "Who wants to be hired?" rows describe people, not jobs: company and roles are empty, and resumeUrl, willingToRelocate and techStack are filled from their post.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep posts that mention any of these anywhere, e.g. "rust", "founding engineer". Case-insensitive.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep posts that offer remote work.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Keep posts whose location or first line mentions any of these, e.g. "London", "NYC", "EU".

techStack.title: Tech stack
techStack.description: Keep posts mentioning any of these technologies, e.g. "Rust", "postgres", "k8s".

minParseConfidence.title: Minimum parse confidence
enumTitles: 0.5: drop posts where little could be read
minParseConfidence.description: Every row has a parseConfidence from 0 to 1.

maxItems.title: Max posts
maxItems.description: Stop after this many rows. Leave empty for all matching posts.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Monitor: only posts added since the last run
mode.description: Schedule monitor mode daily to get new posts as they appear during the month.

monitorStoreName.title: Monitor memory name
monitorStoreName.description: Key-value store that remembers which posts were already returned. Use one name per monitor.
